summary.text: Micaela Cadena, listed by Ballotpedia as Micaela Lara Cadena, is a Democratic state representative from District 33 who has represented the district since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Taxation and Revenue Committee, as vice chair, and the Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee.
